summary.name: Riverside AI Transcription
summary.one_liner: A free online audio and video transcription tool from Riverside that converts recordings to text in 100+ languages with speaker detection and SRT/TXT export.
use_cases: creating subtitles or closed captions for videos
generating show notes or blog posts from recordings
editing video by editing its transcript
summary.what_it_does: Riverside's transcriber accepts uploaded MP3, WAV, MP4 and MOV files and transcribes them automatically using AI speech recognition, with the page claiming up to 99% accuracy across 100+ languages and dialects. The free tool needs no sign-up, and users can choose the language when uploading. Transcripts can be downloaded as TXT (plain text) or SRT (timestamped subtitles). Within Riverside's recorder and online studio, recordings get speaker labels when each participant is on a separate audio track, and the transcript can be used to edit the recording, search text, and generate captions. The page describes transcription times of a few minutes depending on file length.
notable: Unlimited free transcription without sign-up, with a single speaker assigned to multi-speaker uploads
Speaker detection based on separate audio tracks per participant
Exports TXT and SRT subtitle formats
Built-in transcript-based editing and automatic captions in paid studio
caveats: Free plan assigns all text in multi-speaker uploads to one speaker; speaker detection needs separate tracks per person
Full editing suite, speaker detection, audio cleanup and automatic captions require paid plans starting at $24/month
Accuracy is a claimed 'up to 99%' on the vendor's page, not independently verified
